title: Appendix of 28 demonstration experiments with photos and technical build details
description: The paper's appendix documents "28 live demonstration experiments" "including photos and technical details", from a fire tornado and Lord Rayleigh's oil drop experiment to a cloud chamber, a mechanical synchrotron, and a light-suits Higgs collision. The authors say this section "might be the most useful section for many readers", giving specifications on how to build and how best to perform each experiment.
requirements: Transporting all required equipment, filling two vans with a maximum added weight load of 900kg
constraints: Radioactive materials must be transported in a special metal box complying with European Union transport rules
target_learning_goals: communicating basic concepts of elementary particle physics
examples: App. A.4 describes the wooden scattering experiment; App. A.15 the vacuum cannon; App. A.28 the light-suits Higgs collision
